Prompt

Create a bold, disciplined homepage for a martial arts academy called "Iron Path Academy" based in Charlotte, NC. The academy teaches Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, and MMA for kids and adults. The design should feel powerful, focused, and welcoming — balancing intensity with accessibility for beginners.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Iron Path" in a bold condensed font with crossed fist icon, red accent on "Path"
- Links: Programs, Schedule, Instructors, Pricing, About, Blog
- Right side: "Try a Free Class" CTA (solid #DC2626 red), phone number "(704) 555-0318"
- Dark background (#111827 charcoal), sticky on scroll
- Mobile: hamburger with slide-out drawer on dark background

2. HERO SECTION
- Full-width background: cinematic photo of fighters training in a well-lit mat room — one mid-kick on heavy bag, others drilling in pairs
- Overlay content (left-aligned on desktop):
  - Eyebrow badge: "Charlotte's #1 Rated Academy"
  - Headline: "Forge Your Strength. Find Your Path."
  - Subheadline: "Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu · Muay Thai · MMA — for beginners to competitors, ages 5 and up"
  - Two CTAs: "Book Free Trial Class" (solid red #DC2626) + "View Programs" (outline white)
  - Trust badges below CTAs: "4.9★ Google (340 reviews)" · "USA Boxing Certified" · "IBJJF Affiliated"
- Dark gradient overlay from left side for text legibility
- Subtle slow parallax on background image

3. PROGRAMS (tabbed section)
- Section headline: "Choose Your Discipline"
- 3 horizontal tabs: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu | Muay Thai | MMA

- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu tab:
  - Hero image: ground technique demonstration
  - Description: "The gentle art of leverage and control. Learn submissions, sweeps, and escapes from every position. Our BJJ program produces confident grapplers — from your first class to competition-level training."
  - Class types:
    - Fundamentals (White–Blue belt) — Mon/Wed/Fri 6 PM — "Core techniques, positional drilling, and live rolling with guidance"
    - Advanced (Blue belt+) — Tue/Thu 7 PM — "Competition-focused. Advanced guards, passing systems, and strategy"
    - No-Gi Grappling — Sat 10 AM — "Submission wrestling without the kimono. Fast-paced and athletic"
    - Kids BJJ (5–12) — Mon/Wed 4:30 PM — "Coordination, discipline, and anti-bullying confidence"
  - Competitive results: "23 IBJJF medals in 2025 · 4 state champions"

- Muay Thai tab:
  - Hero image: fighter throwing a roundhouse kick on pads
  - Description: "The art of eight limbs. Develop devastating striking with punches, kicks, elbows, and knees. Our Muay Thai program builds real-world striking skills and elite conditioning."
  - Class types:
    - Foundations — Mon/Wed 5 PM — "Stance, basic combos, pad work, heavy bag rounds"
    - All Levels — Tue/Thu 6 PM — "Technical striking, clinch work, sparring drills"
    - Fight Team — Fri 5:30 PM — "For competitors: advanced strategy, sparring, fight prep"
    - Cardio Kickboxing — Sat 9 AM — "High-energy bag workout. No contact, all fitness levels"
  - Competitive results: "8 amateur fighters · 3 regional champions · 28-4 combined record"

- MMA tab:
  - Hero image: cage training with coach cornering
  - Description: "The complete martial artist. Combine striking, wrestling, and submissions into a unified fighting system. Our MMA program integrates BJJ and Muay Thai with wrestling and cage work."
  - Class types:
    - MMA Fundamentals — Tue/Thu 5 PM — "Blending ranges: striking to clinch to ground transitions"
    - Advanced MMA — Mon/Wed 7:30 PM — "Cage strategy, wrestling, fight IQ development"
    - Open Mat — Sun 11 AM — "Free training. All disciplines. Coach supervision available"
  - Competitive results: "12 active amateur fighters · 2 pro fighters on roster"

- Each tab: hero image, description, class grid, competitive callout
- Background: white

4. WHY IRON PATH (value props)

5. BELT PROGRESSION TRACKER (BJJ-specific)
- Section headline: "Your Journey on the Mats"

  - Brown Belt — "Mastery of fundamentals. Refine your A-game." — Avg time: 6–8 years
  - Black Belt — "The beginning of the journey. Lifelong learning." — Avg time: 8–12 years

Design: Bold, disciplined, powerful. Primary: #DC2626 (red), secondary: #111827 (charcoal), accent: #F59E0B (gold for badges and highlights). Backgrounds: white alternating with #F9FAFB (light gray) and #111827 (dark charcoal) sections for dramatic contrast. Typography: Oswald for headings (bold condensed), Inter for body. Cards with 8px border-radius, sharp shadows. Photography should be high-contrast, cinematic gym shots with dramatic lighting. Red accent elements (borders, underlines, icons) throughout. Compact, no-nonsense layout.

Responsive: On mobile, program tabs become a dropdown selector. Class grids stack vertically. Belt progression becomes a vertical timeline. Coach cards become 2-column then single column. Pricing cards stack with "Most Popular" first. Facility photos become swipeable carousel. Trial CTA form goes full-width. Sticky "Free Trial" bar at bottom of screen on mobile. Navigation becomes hamburger with dark drawer.
